en.gameDesc: Work with permutations in cycle notation: compose permutations, decompose into transpositions, and determine even/odd parity.

af.gameDesc: Werk met permutasies in siklusnotasie: stel permutasies saam, ontbind in transposisies, en bepaal ewe/onewe pariteit.

zu.gameDesc: Sebenza namaphermutheshini ngokubhalwa kwesayikili: hlanganisa amaphermutheshini, hlukanisa abe ama-transposition, unqume i-parity elinganayo/engalingani.
